title: Try the demo · AugmentWorks
excerpt: By the end you'll have watched a check catch a bad refund, fail with exit code 10, then pass after a fix, all on your machine.
content_html:
Tutorial · no account

By the end you'll have watched a check catch a bad refund, fail with exit code 10, then pass after a fix, all on your machine.

Before you start

  • Node.js 22.12 or newer. That's all. No account, API key or agent needed.

  1. Check your Node version

    node --version

    You should seev22.12.0 or a later version.

    Older version, or command not found? Install the current LTS release from

    nodejs.org, then open a new terminal and check again.

  2. Run the demo

    It starts a small fictional refund agent with a $50 limit and runs a test suite against it.

    npx --yes @augmentworks/cli@0.4.4 demo

    You should seeThe agent start, then a run where the refund check fails because it tried to refund $80. Exit code 10.

  3. Watch it pass after the fix

    The demo then fixes the agent and runs the same suite again.

    You should seeThe same check pass, exit code 0. Both runs are saved in .augmentworks/demo as JSON, JUnit XML and HTML.

    Nothing left your machine. The demo doesn't use an account, credits or the hosted report.

NextRun your first test on your own agent
